summary: Frontend-only verification of Flowhub manual travel flow revision. All four requested features verified via Playwright on the public preview URL. (1) /ai-travel renders manual-travel-planner-page with zero network calls to any /ai/* endpoint during the entire flow (0 AI calls captured). (2) PIC Accounting can select ticket-option-ka, hotel-option-business, check manual-transport-home-checkbox, click open-travel-review-button (not disabled once a leg is selected), and travel-review-stage renders with editable number inputs (review-ticket-price-input, review-hotel-price-input, review-transport-home-price-input) each accompanied by a file-upload input (ticket-price-proof-input, hotel-price-proof-input, transport-home-proof-input); editing ticket price to 250000 works. (3) Sidebar displays Flowhub branding (STO logo + 'Flowhub' text visible). (4) Manager role loads /approvals (approvals-page) with 4 approval rows each exposing a 'Lihat rincian' button (view-trip-detail-*); clicking opens trip-detail-modal with trip-detail-title 'STO Part & Bahan Bandung' and full RAB details (Wilayah, Cabang, Jadwal, PIC, Budget Rp60.000.000, Status).
critical_code_review_comments: ManualTravelPlannerPage.js is written as a single ~150 char JSX return line — extremely dense, hurts readability/diff-review; consider formatting across multiple lines.

Leg IDs in ManualTravelPlannerPage.js (home/arrival/branch/hotel/return) don't match the semantic testids referenced elsewhere (home-hub / hub-branch / branch-branch / branch-hotel / hotel-hub from previous StagedTravelAssistantPage). If both pages coexist test naming is inconsistent.

Prices state stores strings from <input type='number'>; total = Number(prices.ticket || ticket.price) — if user clears the field to empty string, Number('') = 0 silently instead of falling back to default; use nullish coalescing on prices[key].

File inputs (ticket-price-proof-input etc.) have no onChange handler — files are not captured into state so 'Kirim RAB untuk approval' cannot actually attach the proof; submit-travel-review-button also has no onClick, so submission is a no-op currently.
AccessDenied gate uses role !== 'PIC Accounting' string comparison — brittle to typos; use a constant/enum.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend flow verified end-to-end on public URL. Key testids: manual-travel-planner-page, ticket-option-{ka|bus|flight}, hotel-option-{business|value|premium}, manual-transport-{home|arrival|branch|hotel|return}-checkbox, open-travel-review-button (disabled until >=1 transport leg checked), travel-review-stage, review-ticket-price-input, review-hotel-price-input, review-transport-{legId}-price-input, ticket-price-proof-input, hotel-price-proof-input, transport-{legId}-proof-input, submit-travel-review-button (currently no-op — see code review). Approvals: approvals-page, view-trip-detail-{tripId}, trip-detail-modal, trip-detail-title, close-trip-detail-button. Role selector is reactive without reload.
